s1.quote: The Car Ferry No. 2 Vessel Type : Train Car Ferry Date Built : 1895 … Reason for Loss : Capsized during a storm Depth of Wreck : 45 feet

s2.quote: Vessel Type Car Ferry Barge Year Built 1895 Year Sank 1906 … Lake Michigan State or Province Indiana Depth 42 ft GPS Coordinates 41° 44.965′ N 087° 26.939′ W

summary.text: Remains of a 310-foot wooden railroad car ferry barge that capsized in a storm in 1906 off the Indiana shore of Lake Michigan. Lying in roughly 42 to 45 feet of fresh water, it sank upside down and was later dynamited as a shipping hazard.

sites.depthNote: Agency lists 45 ft, wreck database 42 ft
